title: Term 1 and 2 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 1 and 2.
This question paper consists of 4 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.

questions.prompt: What does the M in SMART stand for?
Decisions made under peer pressure are usually well thought through.
Match each goal to its type.

pairs.left: Open my own business one day

questions.prompt: Rewrite the goal 'I want better marks' as a SMART goal.
questions.memo:
✓ Specific subject and target mark (1)
✓ How it will be measured / achieved (study plan) (1)
✓ A time limit (1)

questions.prompt: Give TWO obstacles that could prevent a learner from reaching a goal, and how to overcome one of them.
questions.memo:
✓ Two obstacles, e.g. no money / no time / no support / lack of motivation (1)
✓ A realistic way to overcome one (1)

questions.prompt: What are values and how do they help in decision-making?
questions.memo:
✓ Beliefs and principles that are important to you (1)
✓ They guide you to choose options that match what you believe is right (1)

questions.prompt: Why is it important to consider consequences before making a decision?
questions.memo:
✓ Decisions have effects on you and others (1)
✓ Thinking ahead helps you avoid harmful outcomes and choose the best option (1)

sections.title: QUESTION 2: Coping with Stress and Emotions

questions.prompt: What is stress?
questions.memo:
✓ The body's and mind's reaction (1)
✓ to pressure or a challenging situation (1)

questions.prompt: Which is a HEALTHY way to cope with stress?
What is the ability to bounce back after difficult experiences called?
What does SADAG stand for?
answers: south african depression and anxiety group

questions.prompt: Depression is a medical condition that can be treated.
Classify each coping strategy.
Describe THREE steps to manage anger in a healthy way.
questions.memo: Any three (1 each): stop and breathe deeply; count to ten; walk away to cool down; exercise; talk calmly using I-statements later; find solutions
